C027.notes: SER EU-IT-006. Boccioni’s Unique Forms of Continuity in Space — Futurism on spare change. RI · R · 2002 · engraver M.A.C. · 12 stars. C055.story: A 2002 Italian 50-euro-cent coin, from the first year of the euro. Italy's side shows the statue of Emperor Marcus Aurelius on horseback on the patterned pavement of the Campidoglio square in Rome. The other side, shared by every euro country, was designed by Luc Luycx. Struck in Nordic gold, a golden copper alloy.

The other side, shared by every euro country, was designed by Luc Luycx. It is made of two metals: a copper-nickel center inside a nickel-brass ring.
